# shadcn/studio MCP (compatibility)

Use `.github/instructions/shadcn-studio-mcp.instructions.md` when the shadcn/studio MCP server is in use. This file is a compatibility alias and is **not** always-on.

Do not apply this workflow to ordinary UI edits. Ordinary UI still uses `packages/ui/AGENTS.md` and exact `base-maia`.
